test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Naveen took two loans, altogether for Rs. 9,400, from Suman and Arya. Suman claimed 12(1)/(2)% simple interest per annum, while Arya claimed 10(1)/(2)% per annum. The total interest paid by Naveen in one year was Rs. 1,063. The sum borrowed from Arya is:
solution:
**Given**

Loan amount = Rs 9400

Simple interest rate on amount of loan taken from Suman = 12(1)/(2)%

Simple interest rate on amount of loan taken from Arya = 101over2% per annum

**Formula used**

Simple interest = (Principal × rate × time)/100

**Calculation**

Let the loan taken from suman is Rs x

and loan taken from Arya is (9400 -x)

interest paid to Suman = (x × 25 × 1)/(100 × 2)

⇒ 25x/200

⇒ x/8

Interest paid to Arya = [(9400 -x) × (21) × 1]/(100 × 2)

⇒ (197400 - 21x)/200

According to question

1063 = (x/8) + (197400 - 21x)/200

⇒ 1063 = (25x + 197400 - 21x)/200

⇒ 1063 = (4x + 197400)/200

⇒ 212600 = 4x + 197400

⇒ 212600 - 197400 = 4x

⇒ 15200 = 4x

⇒ 3800 = x

Sum borrowed from Arya = 9400 - 3800

⇒ 5600

**∴ Amount from Arya is Rs.5600**
